spiritgiven.comments: It was a good game! However, we would like to highlight a few points for improvement: (1) the team was somewhat reactive to the calls; there's room for improvement in this area (2) please remember that individuals off the field cannot make calls and (3) avoid unnecessary contact during the game.

Thank you Hong Kong for the game! We believe there’s room for improvement in communication, particularly by using hand signals for calls. Additionally, please avoid interfering with calls if you're not directly involved or if you're an off-field player
thank you for an intense game!

Many comments made on the side line weren’t made in a good spirit of the game. Many of our players and coaches felt that many Australian players were trying to persuaded our calls into their advantage
Thank you for a great communication during the game! It was a very enjoyable game!
Thank you for a great game! It was amazing playing against you!

Great energy Colombia! Thank you for all your support during the game! We only have one thing to highlight about the fair mindedness: you are always open to dialogue but not very open to reflecting on the calls made. We encourage you to consider whether a call affects the outcome of the play.

Thank you for the game! There were a couple of times where a clarification for the rules was needed. We encourage the team to use the hand signals to help the smoothness of the game. Even though most of our team speaks English, it’s not our first language and the hand signals help to avoid miscommunication. Please, avoid as well getting involve in the calls.

Thank you for another great game! There were a few calls where the GA provided input, but your player did not take it into consideration. We encourage you to also consider their perspective moving forward.

There were several stoppages due to calls that seemed unjustified, with multiple misinterpretations of the rules. We encourage you to have a conversation with some of your players about the SOTG, specifically #90, who was rude and celebrated in an unfriendly manner towards our player over our mistakes. Please be more receptive to our feedback. Although we regularly communicate with the spirit captains, they often took the stance that their calls were right.

spiritreceived.comments:
2. We gave feedback in the first half about body contact and felt that there wasn’t a big adjustment in the second half. 
5. We were all very surprised by the feedback given to us in the spirit circle, considering that nothing was communicated to us at any point during the game and we weren’t given an opportunity to improve. The spirit circle felt negative and took away from the overall enjoyment of the game.
Great game and spirit. Good communication. Loved the energy and the continual checking in from both teams making sure both teams are on the same page. Good sideline conversation from both teams.
A bit more consideration for other teams perspective on calls would be good. Ensuring off field perspectives are kept minimal would be nice.
There were some disparities in the knowledge of rules. Some calls on their side had incorrect knowledge of rules use. It didn't impact the play significantly but it can improve on their side
We respect your consistent attitude throughout the match.Thank you for your kindness. But we think it would be better if we could distinguish between kindness and rules.

There were a number of rules that we felt you didn't know and you used the rules to your advantage throughout the game. Calls were retracted by you when we turned over but we were told by you that we couldn't retract calls when you turned over which is an inconsistent application of the rules. Your sideline was quick to contribute to calls verbally and with gestures before being invited into the discussion. We felt your body contact was good and we had many positive interactions on the sideline.
We appreciate your fair-mindedness. You guys were always great with your gentlemanly attitude and fair judging.
We saw an improvement in some areas. Awareness and avoiding dangerous situations and contact on the field needs to be addressed as well as being open to perspective.
It was a great game. The second half was slightly more physical. There couple of instances that we thought could have been dangerous, but good conversation was had about them.
